text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant-reserved-pool:acme-corp (high i/o latency, 95th > 1200ms) -- PD incident INC-17555
oncall-alice: acked INC-17555 :white_check_mark: I'm on it, reading the metrics now
sre-maya: seeing sustained disk i/o wait on pool-acme-3, io_util ~ 92% across nodes :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploys paused in region us-west-2 due to active incident
oncall-alice: @devops-ryan can you check disk ops on nodes acme-3a/acme-3b? suspected eviction storm
devops-ryan: looking. `ssh node-acme-3a` shows many read retries, kernel logs: `blk_update_request: I/O error` — opening support ticket with infra cloud
oncall-alice: customer-ops-jordan please ping Acme support and say we're investigating an infra-backed latency issue; no config change yet
customer-ops-jordan: pinged Acme (acct: acme-corp). They report increased tail latency after 11:32 UTC, some 429s to inference endpoints, customer impact: ~12% of requests now failing for a small subset of routes
sre-maya: tail latencies correlate with heavy prefix cache churn + disk retries when reserved pool tries to fetch model shards from SSD; KV cache misses spiked at 11:31
oncall-alice: immediate mitigation suggestions?
sre-maya: 2-step: 1) soft-fail new requests onto fallback model variant (lower mem, quantized) for acme routes; 2) scale reserved pool nodes or evacuate problematic nodes
oncall-alice: executing step 1: `redwoodctl routing set --tenant acme-corp --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood/llama-mini-q4f16`
incident-bot: Routing change applied for tenant acme-corp by oncall-alice
oncall-alice: step 1 applied, watch for error rate drop
10m later...
sre-maya: error rate dropped from 12%->4% after fallback; 95p latency down from 1200ms -> 420ms. Good signal :thumbsup:
devops-ryan: trying to drain node-acme-3a: `redwoodctl node drain node-acme-3a --tenant acme-reserved` — noticing stuck processes holding open file descriptors to model shard files
sre-maya: suggests remounting SSDs readonly and restarting runner on nodes with blk errors; but that is a risky op during peak — prefer adding capacity first
oncall-alice: can we add ephemeral burst nodes to the reserved pool?
devops-ryan: provisioning new GPUs in us-west-2 now, `fleetctl scale --pool acme-reserved --add 3` — ETA ~6m
oncall-alice: I'll keep the PD incident open until we confirm full recovery and coordinate postmortem
23:50 later
sre-maya: fleet scale completed, new nodes joined pool, KV miss rate down, tail latency now stable ~210ms, error rate ~0.8% (some retries still)
solutions-elena: confirming with Acme: they report throughput back to normal for their traffic profile; appreciate the fast fallback
oncall-alice: handoff to SRE for cleanup and write-up. @sre-maya take lead on remediation and postmortem please
sre-maya: taking postmortem. Initial hypothesis: transient SSD controller errors caused high read latencies leading to KV cache miss amplification -> increased disk activity -> further IO pressure (feedback loop). Plan: 1) replace affected nodes, 2) improve on-host shard prefetch/backoff, 3) add automatic fallback to quantized variants when reserved pool i/o exceeds threshold, 4) alert tuning to avoid noisy intermediate pages
oncall-alice: adding action items to bridge and tagging owners
incident-bot: INC-17555 status changed to 'acknowledged' by oncall-alice; escalation to SRE level-2 assigned to sre-maya
oncall-alice: leaving a short runbook entry in the incident bridge:```\n- Trigger: PCI for tenant reserved pool latency > 800ms for 5m\n- Immediate action: apply routing fallback to quantized model\n- Secondary action: scale reserved pool or evacuate nodes\n- Owner: oncall -> escalate to SRE if not resolved in 10m\n```
sre-maya: will file JIRA RED-17555 and link logs/trace snippets + kernel OOPS; assigning devops-ryan to node replacement
devops-ryan: will collect kernel logs (`dmesg --ctime | grep -i blk`) and open cloud provider support case for SSD replacement
customer-ops-jordan: Acme confirmed they want a short incident summary for their security/compliance team (include timeline and mitigation) — I'll draft after postmortem
oncall-alice: ack, writing summary and will post in #incidents when ready; marking incident closed in PD once postmortem posted
incident-bot: INC-17555 resolved by oncall-alice at 1755561450 (summary pending) :white_check_mark:
